$comment: Pinned shrink-only baseline for config/read-ceilings.json. The gate FAILS if the manifest's allowlisted-route count OR ceiling sum exceeds these numbers. Lowering either number is always allowed and must happen in the same commit that lowers the manifest. Raising either number is a founder-visible decision, never a silent side effect of adding a route or a read.
